messages:
ashley_sales: Hi team — running into a couple of asks from ProspectX before we sign: they want an endurance run that includes cold-start behavior and a cost estimate for multi-region burst. Can we sketch a plan?

sam_engineer: Quick overview: we'll simulate steady-state at target qps + scheduled spikes, then a cold-start phase where we bring new instances up and ramp traffic. Key metrics: p95/p99 latency, cold-start latency, and throughput drops during evictions.

ashley_sales: Sounds good. They care about 99th percentile under burst and also want to know how much extra $$ for multi-region bursting for 1M tokens/day with two 10-minute spikes/day.

marta_sre: For endurance: recommend 6h steady run at expected qps, then 2x 10m bursts 30m apart, and 30 forced restarts to simulate instance churn. We'll capture warm-up profile (kv cache, model loading).

lee_devops: I'll prep a warmup script. Proposed warmup: run 2 short requests per model shard, then a 60s low-qps prefill to populate KV cache. Example command we'll use for load:```bash
vegeta attack -rate 50 -duration 10m -targets targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > run1.json
```

sam_engineer: Awesome. Note: use a mix of prompt lengths (50/150/500 tokens) because longer sequences change kernel selection and memory pressure. Also test with quantized variant + standard to show tail tradeoffs.

ashley_sales: Security asks: ProspectX needs KMS in transit + audit logs. Can we confirm Private deployment has HSM/KMS + retention policy details?

security_bot: security_checklist:private_deployments: KMS integration available (AWS KMS, GCP KMS), optional HSM for key material. Audit log retention configurable; default 90 days, enterprise can request 365 days.

marta_sre: For the POC results writeup we'll provide: test plan, raw traces, p50/p95/p99 tables, observed cold-start histogram, and a short recommendations section (warmup script + recommended batch sizes).

lee_devops: One operational note: cold-starts correlated with garbage collection on backend process when model shards are loaded concurrently. Mitigation: stagger loads by 5s per shard or pre-warm with a single heavy request to trigger JIT/compilation before traffic.

sam_engineer: Preliminary numbers from yesterday's short run: steady-state qps 60, avg latency 120ms, p95 280ms, p99 540ms. Cold-start median 1.8s, cold-start p95 3.6s (when multiple shards loaded). I'll attach full trace in the doc.

ashley_sales: Pricing ask: can we give them a ballpark cost delta for enabling multi-region burst (replicating N+1 capacity in a second region, autoscaling up for bursts)? They want to know monthly impact.

marta_sre: Ballpark: replicating baseline capacity in second region ~ +85% monthly cost accounting for lower utilization; bursts add short term GPU-hours which we can estimate per spike. For 2x 10m spikes/day at 5 extra instances -> ~ (5 GPUs * 20m/day * 30 days) = 50 GPU-hours/month. Provide both token-based hosted pricing and Dedicated uplift scenarios.

ashley_sales: Great. Can we have a concise one-pager for ProspectX by EOD PST? Include runs, costs, and suggested safeguards (rate-limits, graceful fallback to cheaper quantized model).

lee_devops: I'll drop the warmup script, vegeta targets, and a sample Ansible snippet for staggered shard loads into the shared doc in 30m.

sam_engineer: I'll generate the p99/cold-start histogram and a short blurb explaining kernel-selection effect on long sequences. Also include a recommendation: prefer dynamic KV cache sizes + async prefix caching for chat workloads.

ashley_sales: Perfect — thanks all. If we can get that one-pager + appendix with raw traces, ProspectX legal/security will be happier and we can push the term sheet next week. :thumbsup:
